unsupported_mechanic.ability_reference: FD09/024: [Counter] For this turn, all cards on your opponent's field get power-3000, defense-3000, and critical-1 for each card dropped by this card's [Cast Cost]!
unsupported_mechanic.what_is_known: Variable cost payment modifies dynamic debuff applied to all cards on opponent's field.
information_needed: Approved schema for variable cost multipliers in stat reduction effects.

en.plain:
[Cast Cost] [Drop one or more hand cards]
[Counter] For this turn, all cards on your opponent's field get power-3000, defense-3000, and critical-1 for each card dropped by this card's [Cast Cost]!

[Cast Cost] [ทิ้งการ์ดตั้งแต่ 1 ใบขึ้นไปจากบนมือ]
